header.label: Picture pipeline
header.copied: Source {size}: the video is copied, so the picture is not changed
header.failed: The picture size cannot be computed: {reason}
header.upscaled: The picture is enlarged: it gains no detail.
header.invalid: A picture setting is not valid: see the marked field.

locked.passthrough: The video is copied unchanged, so these settings are not used. Turn off Video passthrough on the Video tab to change the picture.
locked.noVideo: These settings are off: there is no picture to change.

orientation.flipHelp: Mirrors the picture left to right, after the rotation.

crop.modeHelp: Automatic finds the black bars on the sample frames and takes the most common result. Conservative removes only what is black on every sample frame, which is safe for films whose aspect ratio changes. Manual takes your values.
crop.readOnly: Choose Manual to move the edges.

detection.auto: Detected {rect} on the one sample frame | Detected {rect} on {frames} of {total} frames
detection.conservative: Black on the one sample frame: {rect} | Black on every frame: {rect} ({total} frames)
detection.moreBars: Some frames have more black bars: {rect} on {frames} of {total} frames.
detection.group: In a group, Automatic and Conservative detect the black bars of each file when the group is queued. Choose Manual to crop every file the same way.

disagree.issue: Automatic removes {rect}, but only {safe} is black on every sample frame. On the other frames the crop can remove picture.

snap.width: {edge} {from} → {to} (the width must be a multiple of {step})
snap.height: {edge} {from} → {to} (the height must be a multiple of {step})

size.modeHelp: Fit within keeps the aspect ratio and fits the picture inside the box. A portrait picture fits inside the turned box.
size.upscaleHelp: Off: the output is never larger than the source picture's display size.

advanced.pixelAspectHelp: Square pixels play correctly everywhere. Keep source only for DVD-style anamorphic video that you want to store at its original resolution.
advanced.modulusHelp: Rounds the output size to a multiple of this number. Most encoders need 2.
advanced.scalerHelp: Lanczos and Spline are the sharpest and a little slower; Bicubic is a balance; Bilinear is the fastest and the softest.
